resources.string: Add an optional sharing note. It travels with the shared profile and does not change its name. Current vehicle preferences, including unsaved edits, will be included.
Paste the complete shared profile text. Preview it before applying. You can also paste the complete contents of a profile file.
Applying replaces the current vehicle profile and unsaved edits. Hotspot details, authentication, app settings and logs are kept. Changes take effect on the next connection.
This profile is too large for one QR code. Copy its text or save the profile file to share it.
Photograph or save this QR code to share it. The recipient scans it on a phone, copies the text, and pastes it into the head unit.
